calabar: Long time ago for Calabar, one king dey wey dem dey call Efriam Duke, and e no like war at all.
drum: E get one drum, and anytime wey e beat am, feast go just appear.
feast: Fish and fufu, yam and okro, palm oil soup and palm wine, e plenty reach everybody.
enemies: When enemy come, e no dey fight. E go invite dem make dem come chop.
enemies.ask: Why the king dey invite im enemies?
animals: E dey feed im people too, even the animals, because that time everybody dey chop together for peace.
rule: But the drum get one rule.
stick: If the person wey get am waka cross stick wey lie for road, the drum no go bring food again.
egbo: Instead, three hundred Egbo men go come with stick and whip, beat am and all im guests.
wanted: Plenty people want that drum. But the king no gree give anybody.
tortoise: And the one wey want am pass everybody na Tortoise.
spring: One morning, Ikwor Edem, one of the king wife dem, carry her small pikin go one spring make she baff am.
palm: For top of one palm tree near dem, Tortoise dey cut palm nut.
nut: One palm nut fall for the small girl leg.
cried: The pikin start to cry for am, so her mama pick am give her.
mine: Tortoise come down. That palm nut na my own, e talk.
idea: Ikwor Edem explain, but na the drum Tortoise dey think.
justice: Your wife take my food, e tell the king. I want justice.
offers: The king offer am money. Cloth. Palm kernel. Palm oil sef.
choose: At last the king talk say, oya, choose anything wey you want.
point: Tortoise point straight for the drum.
gave: Make the palaver end, the king give am the drum. But e no tell am the rule.
gave.ask: Why the king no tell am the rule?
home: Tortoise carry the drum go house. We no go work for food again, e tell im family.
beat: E beat the drum, and food cover the whole floor.
three-days: For three days, the family chop, laugh, come chop again.
invite: Then e invite the king, the whole town and the animals make dem come one big feast.
laughed: Plenty people laugh. Tortoise, wey poor pass everybody, wan do feast?
few: Na only small people come. But the king come.
appeared: Tortoise beat the drum, and the feast appear for everybody front.
amazed: The guests go house with surprise. The ones wey no come swear say dem go come next time.
amazed.ask: Wetin people dey think about Tortoise now?
boastful: Tortoise come dey lazy and dey form big man, and e dey drink palm wine too much.
farm: One evening, as e dey waka come house from im farm, e no look where e dey go.
stepped: One stick lie for the road, and e waka cross am.
stepped.ask: Wetin Tortoise do wey no good?
nothing: Nothing happen. E no even notice.
breakfast: The next morning, im family wey dey hungry ask for breakfast.
egbo-came: Food no come. Na three hundred Egbo men come instead, with stick and whip.
beaten: Dem beat Tortoise and im whole family.
furious: Tortoise vex well well. But e no blame imself.
plan: If dem go beat me, e think, make dem beat the people wey laugh me too.
second: E invite everybody to another big feast.
crowds: This time the whole town come, plus all the animals, nobody wan miss am again.
stayed: The king and im wives stay for house. Tortoise don already send im own family comot.
doors: When all the guests don enter, dem lock the doors.
bench: Tortoise beat the drum, come hide under one bench.
burst: The Egbo men burst enter with their stick and whip.
nowhere: The guests run, but nowhere dey to run go.
leopard: Na only Leopard escape, e jump cross the compound wall.
opened: At last Tortoise open the doors, beat the drum one special way, and the Egbo men disappear.
limped: The guests dey limp go house, body full of wound, and dem vex well well.
return: So the next morning, Tortoise carry the drum go back to the king.
exchange: Take am back, e talk, and give me farm or cloth instead.
fufu-tree: The king no gree exchange. But e pity Tortoise, so e give am one magic fufu tree.
tree-rule: Every day e dey give fresh fufu and soup. But dem fit collect from am only once a day, no be twice.
tree-rule.ask: Wetin be the fufu tree rule?
calabashes: Every morning Tortoise and im wife go fill their calabash, and the family get plenty food.
son: But one of im pikin wan know where the food dey come from.
secret: Tortoise no gree talk. If the pikin dem find am, their mama talk, dem go spoil am.
ashes: So the boy fill one calabash with ashes, hide am for im papa bag, on top one small hole.
trail: As Tortoise dey waka, small small ashes dey fall for im back.
followed: The boy follow the ashes, watch from inside bush, and e no talk anything.
twice: The next day, after im papa don collect the food, the boy carry im brothers go the tree, and dem collect more.
twice.ask: Wetin the boys do wey no good?
gone: The next morning, the tree don disappear.
thicket: Thick bush don grow overnight. Na only tie-tie palm wey get thorn Tortoise fit see.
nobody: E ask im family who break the rule. Nobody answer.
live-here: So e carry dem go that place. Una break the rule, e talk, so na here we go live.
why: And na why, the old people talk, tortoise dey live under tie-tie palm wey get thorn.
why.ask: Why tortoise dey live under palm?
